notes.title: Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone :)

Great news, my game Road Z : The Last Drive works on the Steam Deck, here is the right settings to make it works with a stable 40 fps.

In the settings of the game, set the screen resolution of 1280 x 800 and set the graphics to Medium and set the Shadow Quality to Low.

In the Performance menu of the Steam Deck, select the Framerate Limit to 40 fps and also the Refresh Rate to 40 fps, Turn ON the TDP and set the Watts to 15.

Have Fun!

notes.title: New game in development
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am happy to inform you that I am developing a new original game named  Zeltoid X1. 

This is an adventure game made in voxel where you will have to help a little robot named Zeltoid to save his planet. 

The game is in the early stages of development and I invite you to follow me for more information in the coming weeks. 

I will be creating a Steam page for this game soon, but in the meantime you can follow me on my Discord. I share with you a very first image in development.

notes.notes:
Hello, I have added more specific information on the mechanics of the game.
